offering_description.value: Operates regional theme parks with marine animal habitats, animal shows, thrill rides and water attractions. It sells park admission, annual passes and in-park food and merchandise to families and tourists across the United States.

primary_products.value: food and beverage; merchandise; souvenirs; annual passes

primary_services.value: theme park admission; live entertainment shows; animal care and rescue; group and event hosting

customer_segment.value: B2C: families, tourists and local residents buying tickets and annual passes

end_markets.value: family entertainment; leisure and tourism; hospitality

revenue_model.value: service fees: admission tickets and access to park attractions; subscription: annual passes and memberships; product sales: food, beverages and merchandise sold inside parks

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs its theme parks, animal habitats and rides; service provider: takes in guest admission and spending and sells experiences to individual visitors

geography_served.value: US national: parks in Florida, Texas, California, Virginia, Ohio and other US states

specialization.value: related lines: marine animal parks, animal-themed parks, water parks and themed resort attractions

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated theme parks; online: websites and apps for ticket and annual pass sales; partners / resellers: travel agents and ticket resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: animal welfare rules under USDA and the Animal Welfare Act, state and local ride safety and health inspections
